verdict.rationale: Appwrite's first-party docs say email/password login takes "just a few lines of code" with Argon2 hashing. They also say GitHub, Google, Facebook, Apple and 30+ other OAuth providers can be enabled from the Console's Social providers tab for one-click sign-up. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that setup takes minutes, and explicit SDK-level detail for the OAuth sign-in flow.
